title: Blitz: Accelerating the Diffusion Modules of AlphaFold3 and Boltz-2
abstract: arXiv:2610.23703v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Diffusion-based protein structure prediction models produce all-atom structures in about 200 denoising steps, and that cost has driven a number of few-step samplers. We present Blitz, a few-step distillation framework that uses a geometric noise schedule to distribute steps more evenly across noise scales, then learns those updates through multistep consistency training. Physical steering and target-free candidate selection help reduce the remaining geometric defects at inference. We apply Blitz to AlphaFold 3 and Boltz-2, reducing denoising from 200 steps to eight. Because published few-step results use different benchmarks and scoring procedures, we compare both distilled models with their teachers and other few-step methods under a common evaluation protocol covering structural accuracy, interface quality, ligand placement, and stereochemical validity. translated_abstract: 基于扩散模型的蛋白质结构预测模型需要大约200个去噪步骤来生成全原子结构，这一高昂的计算成本催生了多种少步采样器。我们提出了Blitz，一个少步蒸馏框架，它使用几何噪声调度将采样步骤更均匀地分布在不同噪声尺度上，然后通过多步一致性训练来学习这些更新。物理导向和无目标候选选择有助于在推理阶段减少剩余的几何缺陷。我们将Blitz应用于AlphaFold 3和Boltz-2，将去噪步骤从200步减少到8步。由于已发表的少步方法结果使用了不同的基准测试和评分程序，我们在统一的评估协议下将两个蒸馏模型与其教师模型以及其他少步方法进行比较，该协议涵盖结构准确性、界面质量、配体放置和立体化学有效性。Blitz保持了教师模型级别的结构准确性，其中AF3-Blitz的表现优于所有已发表的……（原文在此处截断）
tldr: Blitz是一个少步蒸馏框架，通过几何噪声调度和多步一致性训练，将AlphaFold 3和Boltz-2的扩散去噪步骤从200步大幅加速至8步，同时保持与教师模型相当的结构预测准确性。
en_tdlr: Blitz is a few-step distillation framework that accelerates the diffusion denoising of AlphaFold 3 and Boltz-2 from 200 steps to just 8 steps while retaining teacher-level structural accuracy, by leveraging a geometric noise schedule and multistep consistency training.
